inputs.prompt: Reimagine this as an upscale restaurant marketing photograph. Softly blurred warm dark restaurant backdrop with ambient bokeh lighting, shallow depth of field, dramatic side lighting, high-end editorial food photography, 85mm lens. Remove all background clutter, utensils, and counter surfaces. Replate the bone-in tomahawk ribeye with sauteed mushrooms and bearnaise sauce onto an elegant modern white plate: steak angled to show the full long bone, mushrooms in a tidy cluster, bearnaise in a small clean ramekin or neat quenelle rather than a metal cup. Keep the steak's char and doneness exactly as they are.
